title: Devil is in the Queries: Advancing Mask Transformers for Real-world Medical Image Segmentation and Out-of-Distribution Localization
mechanism: Object queries act as feature cluster centres; pixel-to-query similarity gives an OOD map (MaxQuery); a query-distribution loss separates targets from background at query level.
adaptation: E1 decoys: scuff streaks and half-cut layouts are OOD; use the MaxQuery map from the EoMT or M2F arm to suppress crack predictions where pixels are far from every query, or report it as an abstention score in the benchmark.
min_experiment: Inference-only filter on the trained mask classifier vs same model unfiltered; metric E1 crack relP@2 at fixed relR@2 and false-alarm px on half-cut scuff cells; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: pancreatic and liver tumour segmentation, +5.27 DSC over nnU-Net on inliers; OOD AUROC +7.39, AUPR +14.69, FPR95 -13.79 vs previous SOTA.
prior_overlap: none: anomaly priors and OOD scoring never tried.
